paper_metadata.title: Time dependence in diffusion MRI predicts tissue outcome in ischemic stroke patients

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study provides clear inclusion/exclusion criteria and describes the baseline characteristics of the small sample. However, the sample size is extremely small (n=5), and it is unclear how many eligible patients were screened but not recruited, raising concerns about the representativeness of the sample.
